title: Purple Warrior Poses
description: Four identical poses of a dark-skinned female warrior with short silver hair are displayed side by side against a solid black background. She wears an ornate purple and silver fantasy armor outfit with leaf-like patterns, arm wraps, and purple leg wraps, standing in a wide combat stance with purple energy effects emanating from her shoulders.
prompt: A dark-skinned female warrior with short spiky silver hair, wearing intricate purple and silver fantasy armor with leaf-shaped metal pieces, arm wraps, and purple leg wraps, standing in a powerful wide combat stance with one arm forward. Purple magical energy swirls around her shoulders. Four identical views of the same character are shown side by side against a pure black background, highly detailed 3D render.
